newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices recoup losses to end higher.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices recoup losses to end higher.

text.p: Indian castorseed December delivery recovered to close at 1,141/1,142 rupees per quintal on Monday on renewed buying after falling to 1,134/1,135 rupees, dealers said.
"Lower than expected rainfall in producing centres triggered fresh support at lower levels," one dealer said.
"Groundnut oil fell two rupees to 432/433 rupees per 10 kg rupees," one miller said. "Increased supplies of imported palm oil and sliding prices put pressure on groundnut oil," he said.
Rajkot spot oil was up 15 rupees to 695/700 rupees per 15 kg on shortage of ready stock.--Bombay Commodities +91-22-265 9000
